mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 61 degrees under an overcast sky with a full moon visible over Verona Community Park. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 58 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast for the night.

The Planning Department has issued a scam alert for applicants receiving fake emails requesting payments via wire transfer or online credit cards. Official City of Verona communications will only come from an address ending in at veronawi.gov, and all fees must be paid via check at the City Administration Building on Lincoln Street.

There is plenty to do in our city! Today, you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness or head to Hop Haus Brewing for trivia. Tomorrow, don't miss the award-winning Verona Fall Fest at Hometown USA Festival Park or live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard.

In our weekly report, on September 5th, officers were called to investigate a series of vehicles with cheese slices placed on their windshields, which turned out to be a viral social media prank known as the Dairy Dare.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for the night. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow morning when the store opens at 10:00 AM to serve up our next flavor of the day.
